title: Controllers and agents
summary: The Jenkins controller coordinates work. An agent is an environment where jobs can execute.
introduction: The Jenkins controller coordinates work. An agent is an environment where jobs can execute. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The Jenkins controller coordinates work. An agent is an environment where jobs can execute.

blocks.code:
Controller: schedules and records jobs
Agent: runs the assigned build steps
blocks.title: Controllers and agents

blocks.text: Separating these roles helps explain where work happens. A small learning installation may look simpler, but the roles still matter.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw a controller assigning work to two agents.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not give a build more access to the host machine than it needs.
For more detail later, use this [Jenkins further reading](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/).
